card.title: Quiet hours & completion
card.description: Postpone resource-intensive work, run something once the queue is empty, and hold the queue on battery or a metered connection.

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.description: Deferred work waits inside these windows. Downloads themselves keep running.
quiet.defer_notifications: Group notifications until the window ends

completion.label: When the queue is empty
completion.description: Runs once per completed cycle of work, after post-processing has finished too.
completion.script_description: A file in the post-processing scripts directory; the same sandbox and timeout apply.
completion.countdown_description: Time to cancel before the action runs (10–3600 s).
completion.approval_label: Allow power actions on this machine
completion.approval_description: Standby and shutdown only run once this is switched on here.
completion.approval_missing: Without this approval the action is configured but never runs.

context.unavailable: This platform cannot report it, so the policy stays off.
context.prevent_standby_description: While a download or unpacking is actually running. A queue that is only waiting does not hold the machine open.
context.prevent_display_description: For a machine somebody watches. A download itself needs no lit screen.
context.inhibiting: The machine is being kept awake.

pending.countdown: In {seconds} s — cancel to keep the machine on.

paused.battery: The queue is paused: the machine is running on battery.
paused.metered: The queue is paused: the connection reports itself as metered.
